data.desc: Algorhythm Holdings, Inc. is a holding company with two businesses: Azure Energy and SemiCab Holdings. Azure Energy provides strategic and technical advisory services for renewable biomass power generation infrastructure. It helps its customers develop bankable, firm-capacity renewable energy infrastructure that converts biomass into clean, dispatchable power for data center and large industrial off-take markets. For additional information, please go to: http://www.azure-energy.co. SemiCab is an AI technology company that has enabled major retailers, brands and transportation providers to address common supply-chain problems globally. Its AI-enabled, cloud-based Collaborative Transportation Platform achieves the scalability required to predict and optimize millions of loads and hundreds of thousands of trucks.
